name: Shree Bhavya Fabrics Limited
about: Shree Bhavya Fabrics Limited engages in the manufacture, distribution, and marketing of textile products in India. It is also involved in dyeing, printing, and stitching activities. In addition, the company offers bottom weight fabrics, including dobbies, double cloth, corduroys, cotton twills, cotton tussars, cotton viscose, micro tussars, pc x pc, etc.; and shirting fabrics, such as cotton, casual, plaid, striped, micro-dot, classic, military, and western shirting fabrics, as well as home furnishings products, including cushion and bed sheets. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Anjani Dham Industries Limited and changed its name to Shree Bhavya Fabrics Limited in September 2014. Shree Bhavya Fabrics Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
